task.title: Chat with a match
task.shortdesc: After you match, you can send text messages. They arrive right away while you're together, or the next time you're close with open on both phones.

step.cmd: On the Match screen, tap Chat.
step.info: You can also open the Chats tab and tap the conversation.

step.cmd: Type your message in Write a message… and tap Send.
step.info: Messages are text only, up to 1,000 characters.

result.p: The top of the chat shows whether messages arrive now:

li.msgph: Nearby now. Messages arrive right away.
Not nearby. Messages arrive when you're together again with OMNI open on both phones.
